sources.title: On-Device LLMs: State of the Union, 2026
sources.key_finding: Major breakthroughs came from model architecture, compression and deployment rather than faster chips. Mobile NPUs approach 45-75 TOPS; memory bandwidth (50-90 GB/s) is the binding constraint.

sources.title: Best Phones for AI Professionals 2026
sources.key_finding: Recommended 2026 edge LLM models: Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Qwen3-8B. Thermal management supersedes peak compute as primary constraint.

sources.title: Fast On-device LLM Inference with NPUs (ASPLOS '25)
sources.key_finding: llm.npu: first LLM system using on-device NPU offloading; achieves 22.4x faster prefill, 30.7x energy savings, >1000 tokens/sec prefilling for 1B-param model.

sources.title: Fast On-device LLM Inference with NPUs (arxiv PDF)
sources.key_finding: llm.npu reduces prefill latency by 18.17-38.4x on Redmi K70 Pro vs llama.cpp-CPU for 1024 token prompts.

sources.title: Scaling LLM Test-Time Compute with Mobile NPU on Smartphones (EuroSys '26)
sources.key_finding: First work on LLM test-time scaling on mobile. Hardware-aware tile quantization, up to 19x GEMM speedup and 2.2x Softmax speedup on Snapdragon platforms.

sources.title: LLM Inference at the Edge: Mobile, NPU, and GPU Trade-offs (2026)
sources.key_finding: Benchmarks Qwen2.5-1.5B (4-bit) on Pi5+Hailo-10H, Galaxy S24 Ultra, iPhone 16 Pro, RTX 4050. iPhone 16 Pro loses 50% throughput within 2 iterations due to thermal throttling.

sources.title: On-Device LLMs in 2026: What Changed, What Matters, What's Next
sources.key_finding: Phi-4-Mini 3.8B runs ~22 tok/s on MacBook M4 Air. Qwen 2.5 3B is best quality/param under 4B. Major labs converge on 1-8B parameter models for edge.

sources.title: Apple Neural Engine Wikipedia
sources.key_finding: A18/A18 Pro: 35 TOPS, 16-core Neural Engine. M4: 38 TOPS, 2.1x M3.

sources.title: Apple M4 Wikipedia
sources.key_finding: M4 Neural Engine: 38 TOPS.

sources.title: Orion: Characterizing and Programming Apple's Neural Engine for LLM Training and Inference
sources.key_finding: First open end-to-end system for ANE LLM inference and training. On M4 Max: 170+ tokens/s for GPT-2 124M. Reduces recompilation from 4200ms to 494ms (8.5x speedup). Discovers 14 new ANE MIL IR constraints.

sources.title: Apple A19 Processor - Wikipedia
sources.key_finding: A19/A19 Pro: TSMC N3P 3nm process, 16-core Neural Engine with improved memory bandwidth, FP16 throughput doubled vs A18, per-core neural accelerators in GPU pipeline. Ships in iPhone 17 (Sep 2025).

sources.title: Apple M5 Neural Engine - Apple Newsroom
sources.key_finding: M5: ~133 TOPS Neural Engine (12x M1). New GPU-integrated Neural Accelerator per core. 4x peak GPU compute for AI vs M4. Announced Oct 2025.

sources.title: Apple M5 Pro and M5 Max
sources.key_finding: M5 Pro/Max announced March 2026. Higher-bandwidth Neural Engine connection to memory. Up to 40-core GPU with per-core Neural Accelerators.

sources.title: Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 Launch
sources.key_finding: 37% faster Hexagon NPU over predecessor. ~100 TOPS. Direct Link, Micro Tile Inferencing, mixed precision INT4/INT8/INT16/FP16.

sources.title: Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 - Counterpoint Research
sources.key_finding: 100 TOPS NPU; FastVLM TTFT 0.12s on high-res images; >11,000 tokens/sec prefill, >100 tokens/sec decode on NPU.

sources.title: MediaTek Dimensity 9400+ Enhancement
sources.key_finding: NPU 890: supports MoE, MLA, MTP, FP8. 20% faster agentic AI with SpD+. First on-device high-quality video generation. First on-device LoRA training. Announced April 2025.

sources.title: MediaTek Dimensity 9400 Features
sources.key_finding: NPU 890 flagship; Dimensity Agentic AI Engine (DAE) enables agentic app development.

sources.title: Samsung Exynos 2500 Semiconductor Page
sources.key_finding: 59 TOPS NPU, 24K MAC capability (39% improvement), 90% improvement on MobileBERT. 3nm GAA process. Launched June 2025.

sources.title: Samsung Exynos 2600 Semiconductor Page
sources.key_finding: World's first 2nm GAA mobile chip. 113% generative AI performance improvement over Exynos 2500. Nota AI partnership reduces model size by 90% with maintained accuracy. Announced Dec 19, 2025.

sources.title: Google Tensor G5 Specs and Benchmarks
sources.key_finding: Tensor G5: TSMC 3nm. 60% better NPU vs G4. Gemini Nano 260% faster, 50% less power. Context window up to 32K tokens (from 12K). Announced Aug 2025.

sources.title: VeriSilicon Ultra-Low Energy NPU 40+ TOPS
sources.key_finding: VeriSilicon ultra-low energy NPU: >40 TOPS for on-device LLM inference in mobile applications.

sources.title: Ultra-Low-Power MCUs in 2026: AI-Enabled Microcontrollers and TinyML
sources.key_finding: 2026 MCUs run AI inference without battery drain. ST Cortex-M33 parts with ML headroom, toolchain v9.x. Designers evaluate energy per inference, memory headroom, AI toolchain maturity.

sources.title: MLPerf Tiny v1.3 Benchmark Results Released (Sep 2025)
sources.key_finding: New 1D DS-CNN wake-word detection test added. STM32 NUCLEO-U385RG-Q: 48+ inferences/sec keyword spotting at 245mW. Renesas, STMicro, Syntiant participants.

sources.title: MLCommons MLPerf Tiny v1.3 - Hackster.io
sources.key_finding: MLPerf Tiny benchmarks include keyword spotting, image recognition at low resolution, and anomaly detection from sensor data.

sources.title: Deploying TinyML for Energy-Efficient Object Detection
sources.key_finding: TinyML deployment for energy-efficient object detection in low-power edge AI systems.

sources.title: Sustainable LLM Inference for Edge AI: Evaluating Quantized LLMs
sources.key_finding: 28 quantized LLMs on Raspberry Pi 4 (4GB RAM). q3/q4 cut energy up to 79% vs FP16. Mathematical reasoning degrades significantly below q4. Published Apr 2025.

sources.title: EntroLLM: Entropy Encoded Weight Compression for Edge LLM Inference
sources.key_finding: Mixed quantization + entropy coding: up to 30% storage savings over uint8, 65% over uint4. 31.9-146.6% faster inference on NVIDIA Jetson P3450. Published May 2025.

sources.title: Give Me BF16 or Give Me Death? LLM Quantization Trade-offs
sources.key_finding: FP8 effectively lossless across all model scales. Well-tuned INT8 achieves 1-3% accuracy degradation. INT4 weight-only competitive, rivaling INT8.

sources.title: RISC-V Processors for Edge AI Devices - 129M Shipments by 2030
sources.key_finding: RISC-V AI device shipments to reach 129M by 2030. Edge AI processor market expected $13.5B in 2025.

sources.title: Energy-Efficient Dual-Core RISC-V Architecture for Edge AI
sources.key_finding: Dual-core RISC-V with dynamic MAC unit reuse for edge AI acceleration.

sources.title: Chiplet-Based RISC-V SoC with Modular AI Acceleration
sources.key_finding: Novel chiplet RISC-V SoC: 14.7% latency reduction, 17.3% throughput improvement, 16.2% power reduction vs basic chiplet. 40.1% efficiency gain. 3.5 mJ per MobileNetV2 inference.

sources.title: GreenWaves GAP9 Ultra-Low Power IoT Processor
sources.key_finding: GAP9: RISC-V, 22nm FDX, 50 GOPS at 50mW, 41.6 GB/s cluster memory bandwidth. 5x lower power than GAP8. Medical wearables, hearables, drones.

sources.title: Hailo-10H Edge AI Accelerator
sources.key_finding: Hailo-10H: 40 TOPS INT4 / 20 TOPS INT8, 2.5W, M.2 form factor, 4/8GB LPDDR4X on-module. First edge accelerator <5W running LLMs. Commercial availability July 2025.

sources.title: Axelera Metis AIPU
sources.key_finding: Metis: 214 TOPS INT8, ~15 TOPS/W, 5-9W typical. Quad-core version: ~856 TOPS.

sources.title: Axelera Europa AIPU Launch (Oct 2025)
sources.key_finding: Europa AIPU: up to 629 TOPS INT8 for edge servers and enterprise systems. Announced Oct 2025.

sources.title: ARM Ethos-U85 NPU
sources.key_finding: Ethos-U85: 128-2048 MACs, up to 4 TOPS @ 1GHz, 4x perf uplift, 20% more energy efficient than Ethos-U55. Supports Transformers and CNNs.

sources.title: Alif Ensemble E4/E6/E8 with Ethos-U85
sources.key_finding: Alif Ensemble E4: dual Cortex-M55 + Ethos-U85, 36mW for SLM inference, <2ms object detection, <8ms image classification.

sources.title: Evaluating Energy Efficiency of NPU-Accelerated MCU Inference
sources.key_finding: Arm Cortex-M55 + Ethos-U55 on Alif E7: latency improvements 7x-125x, energy reductions up to 143x for moderate/large networks vs CPU-only.

sources.title: Benchmarking Ultra-Low-Power μNPUs
sources.key_finding: First independent benchmarks for multiple commercial μNPUs. MAX78000 outperforms others in energy-efficiency. MCXN947: 4.8 GOPS, 512KB RAM. Unexpected scaling disparities found.

sources.title: eIQ Neutron: Redefining Edge-AI Inference with Integrated NPU
sources.key_finding: NXP eIQ Neutron NPU: 172x AI speedup, 119x energy reduction vs Cortex-M33 alone. 1.8x speedup at equal TOPS vs competitors; 3.3x vs NPUs with 2x resources.

sources.title: Ambiq Atomiq Ultra-Low Power NPU SoC
sources.key_finding: Ambiq Atomiq: first SoC with sub/near-threshold voltage for AI. Ethos-U85 NPU, 200+ GOPS, 300mV operation. Announced Jan 2026 at CES.

sources.title: Sparse Neural Network Pruning for Edge Deployment 2025
sources.key_finding: SET-pruned sparse ANNs achieve energy savings without accuracy compromise. Structured pruning best for hardware acceleration; unstructured achieves higher compression.

sources.title: SparseDVFS: Sparse-Aware DVFS for Energy-Efficient Edge Inference
sources.key_finding: Block-level DVFS using sparsity as frequency modulation metric. 78.17% average energy efficiency gain over SOTA. 14% cost-gain ratio. Published March 2026.

sources.title: TSMC 2nm Mass Production Q4 2025
sources.key_finding: TSMC N2: mass production started Q4 2025. 10-15% perf improvement at same power, 25-30% power reduction at same perf. All 2026 capacity booked: Apple >50%, plus Qualcomm, MediaTek, AMD, NVIDIA.

sources.title: Samsung Exynos 2600 2nm Launch Dec 2025
sources.key_finding: World's first 2nm mobile chip (Samsung SF2). 113% gen AI improvement. Galaxy S26 debut expected Q1 2026.

sources.title: Intel Loihi 3 Neuromorphic Chip 2026
sources.key_finding: Loihi 3: 50-100 μW for complex AI workloads (vs 50-100 mW on traditional processors, ~1000x reduction). Commercial availability Q4 2026.

sources.title: AMD Versal AI Edge Series Gen 2
sources.key_finding: Versal AI Edge Gen 2: AIE-ML + DSP engines for edge inference. Targets automotive ADAS, healthcare, aerospace.

sources.title: ExecuTorch 1.0 GA - On-Device AI Deployment
sources.key_finding: ExecuTorch production-ready, powers Meta apps (Instagram, WhatsApp, Ray-Ban Glasses). 50KB base footprint, 12+ hardware backends, supports Llama, Qwen 3, Phi-4-mini.

sources.title: Edge and Mobile LLM Leaderboard 2026
sources.key_finding: Phi, Gemma, Qwen leading edge LLM leaderboard. Phi-4-Mini 3.8B: 88.6% GSM8K, 83.7% ARC-C.

sources.title: Benchmarking Energy and Latency in TinyML (2025)
sources.key_finding: Novel benchmarking methodology for precise energy, latency and system efficiency measurement on MCUs. Published May 2025.

sources.title: Efficient MoE LLM Inference with Apple Silicon NPUs
sources.key_finding: MoE LLM inference optimization specifically for Apple ANE. Published April 2026.

sources.title: Challenging GPU Dominance: When CPUs Outperform for On-Device LLM Inference
sources.key_finding: Investigates scenarios where CPU outperforms GPU for on-device LLM inference, including Apple M3/M4 chips. Published May 2025.
